segments.text: So. Do you carry her off and let Emberwick freeze, or leave her to the town and the Market? I've an offer, if you're asking.

segments.speaker: rook
segments.text: Guards on my pier. Lovely. They'll be colder than I am by morning, and twice as bored.

segments.speaker: rook
